items.criterion: GET /api/chapters returns all five chapters with their slug, index label, eyebrow, title and published flag, in index order.
items.judgment: Read the array back and compare the slug set and the ordering against the seed.

items.criterion: The chapter table holds exactly five rows, two of them published, and a restart adds none.
items.judgment: Count the rows and compare the published subset against color and logo.

items.criterion: An unpublished chapter is refused to a signed-out caller at its own address and at its sections address.
items.judgment: Request both addresses with no credential and read the status.

items.criterion: An unpublished chapter owned by one author is refused to the other author at every address.
items.judgment: Request the chapter, its sections and its publish endpoint as the non-owning author.

items.criterion: Every media row has a real object in the bucket at the key the scheme pins, and every object under the prefix has a row.
items.judgment: List the bucket prefix and join it against the media rows in both directions.

items.criterion: The bytes served for a published chapter's picture hash to the digest stored beside the row.
items.judgment: Fetch the stream and compare the digest of the body against the stored digest.

items.criterion: A draft chapter's picture is refused to a signed-out caller and to a reader.
items.judgment: Request the media stream as each of the two and read the status.

items.criterion: Two submissions of one trial address leave exactly one row, and the first row's moment does not move.
items.judgment: Submit twice, count the rows for that address and compare the stored moment.

items.criterion: A reorder of a chapter's sections leaves the positions contiguous from one.
items.judgment: Reorder three sections and read the stored positions back.

items.criterion: A reader is refused the trial list, chapter creation and publication at the API.
items.judgment: Call each endpoint with a reader token and read the status.

items.criterion: Twelve tone stops are stored, one per tone group per tier, and the phone grounds differ from the desktop grounds.
items.judgment: Read the tone stop rows and compare the desktop and mobile grounds.

items.criterion: An address the product does not have answers not-found rather than rendering another page with a success status.
items.judgment: Request an unknown address and read the status.

items.criterion: The sitemap lists the two published chapters and names no unpublished one.
items.judgment: Fetch the sitemap and compare the routes it names against the published set.

items.criterion: Signing out invalidates the token, so a request replaying it afterwards is denied.
items.judgment: Sign out and replay the same token against an author-only read.
